"""Create a deterministic zip archive.

Usage: python3 make-release.py <zip-path> <member> [<member> ...]

Members are stored in the given order with fixed 2-digit-second precision
mtimes as recorded on disk (caller is responsible for setting them).
zipfile writes no extra fields, so with fixed mtimes the output is
byte-deterministic.
"""
import sys
import zipfile

zip_path = sys.argv[1]
members = sys.argv[2:]

with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=9) as z:
    for m in members:
        z.write(m)
